name: FortiVPN
author: Christian Palladini
description: FortiClient VPN status in the Omarchy bar: connection state, assigned IP, uptime and traffic, with one-click disconnect and a shortcut into the SAML login.

barWidget.description: Watch the FortiClient tunnel, disconnect from the bar, and open the GUI when a fresh SSO login is needed.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the tunnel is polled. The duration counter ticks between polls, so a slower interval still reads smoothly.

schema.label: Hide the icon while the tunnel is down
Notify when the tunnel drops on its own
schema.description: A disconnect you asked for stays silent.

schema.label: Notify when the tunnel comes up
Path to the fortivpn CLI
schema.description: Leave empty to find fortivpn on PATH.

schema.label: Command that opens the FortiClient GUI
schema.description: Used by Connect, because SAML/SSO login has to happen in the GUI's browser flow.
